Gulf of America including Dry Tortugas and Rebecca Shoal Channel...

At 1142 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a a strong thunderstorm,
capable of producing wind gusts near 30 knots. This thunderstorm was
located over Dry Tortugas Light, or over Fort Jefferson, moving
northwest at 10 knots.

Locations that will be affected include...
Fort Jefferson, Dry Tortugas, Dry Tortugas Light, and Tortugas
Ecological Reserve North.
properties.instruction:

rough and confused seas, occasional lightning strikes, and
potentially blinding downpours. Get to a safe port as quickly, and as
safely as possible. When downpours reduce visibility, slow down.

properties.areaDesc: Grande Ronde Valley
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 8:04PM PDT by NWS Pendleton OR
properties.description:
Elevated fire weather conditions persist through the overnight
hours tonight in the Grande Ronde Valley as dry air and breezy to
locally windy conditions continue. Minimum relative humidity
levels will improve up to 30-35% through the evening hours with
fair to moderate overnight recoveries expected. Sustained winds,
however, will continue to be 20-30 mph with gusts up to 35 mph
through the overnight hours. Winds will weaken as we head into
the mid to late morning hours on Saturday.

There also exist a chance of localized blowing dust associated
with the breezy winds that can bring major impacts to visibility
along roadways, including portions of interstate 84.

properties.areaDesc: Ventura County Beaches; Ventura County Inland Coast; Malibu Coast
properties.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 16 at 7:50PM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Wind Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with
gusts of 35 to 55 mph expected. For the Heat Advisory, temperatures
up to 95 expected.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast, Ventura County Beaches, and Ventura County
Inland Coast.

* WHEN...For the Heat Advisory, until 8 PM PDT Saturday. For the Wind
Advisory, until 2 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Hot
temperatures may cause heat illnesses.
properties.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

In the event of a nearby wildfire, smoke may increase heat and
physical stress. If smoke impacts your area; 1) Have a cooling plan
in place as smoke could limit your ability to cool your home through
open windows and 2) If you have air conditioning, set on air
recirculation within the home to avoid smoke exposure. Local
officials may have additional guidance.
